name: Lunar Polar Water-Ice Prospecting v1
description: The Phase-0 anchor benchmark (scenarios/1-lunar-polar-ice-prospecting.md §13): a heterogeneous swarm prospects the permanently shadowed regions of the Shackleton-de Gerlache ridge for water ice, then excavates, hauls, extracts, purifies, and stores it, surviving the lunar night under power and comms-window constraints. Content is pinned by hash for byte-for-byte reproducibility; every content_hash is a REAL Hub artifact digest published by RM-P1-WORLDS-15 (world) / RM-P1-FLEET-10 (fleet) / RM-P1-PROSPECT-13 (prospect), and Sim resolves them into a runnable Scenario (RM-P1-SIM-01). The world is the LOLA LDEM_875S_5M bundle (SPICE DE440 illumination + PSR) built by astro-mine-worlds scripts/build_shackleton_anchor.py - see PROVENANCE.md. This scenario does not exercise the operational_targeting dual-use gate (scenario §14). Version 0.6.0 pins two things the spec previously could not express (astro-mine-bench#63, astro-mine-sim#66): placement, so the swarm's siting is a property of the task rather than a jitter derived from the content digest that moved on every re-pin and contradicted the pinned contact plan; and the belief/discovery scoring parameters, whose runner-side defaults were unsatisfiable (characterized_variance_threshold 0.0) or trip at tick 0 (discovery_threshold 0.0). The four surface sites carry the latitudes and longitudes astro-mine-link's anchor computed its contact plan against, so comms geometry and physics now agree on where the swarm is. Version 0.7.0 drops the elevations 0.6.0 had copied from that same source: measured against this scenario's own pinned world, Link's figures are off the DEM by -4436 m (prospecting-rover), -3276 m (excavator), +1617 m (hauler) and +301 m (isru-plant), which would have started two of the four assets kilometres *beneath* the terrain - buried, and occluded for line-of-sight by the ground they are inside. Link's elevations are descriptive of its own geometry and were never sampled from this world bundle. Omitting elevation_m instead makes each site snap to the pinned DEM, which is strictly more reproducible: the terrain is pinned by hash, so a site cannot drift from the world the run actually uses. cell_area_m2 62500.0 is the pinned prior's own 250 m grid pitch squared; characterized_variance_threshold 0.00021025 is the PSR prior sigma (0.029, LCROSS Cabeus) halved, i.e. a cell counts as characterized once its posterior uncertainty is half the prior's - the scenario document leaves this as 'reduced >= X%' (§3), so this is where X is chosen; discovery_threshold 0.01 is twice the LEND polar background WEH (0.005), well below the 0.056 LCROSS peak.

world.description: Shackleton-de Gerlache ridge, lunar south pole, version 0.4.0 - the first anchor world to ship its horizon map (illumination/horizon.zarr), so resolving it takes ~3 s instead of re-deriving a 192-million-entry skyline from the packaged DEM on every load (astro-mine-worlds#46). Its terrain and regolith rasters are byte-identical to the prior bundle; what moved is the PSR mask, which is now the spec-driven, validated one: PSR area fraction 0.1464 against the LOLA reference 0.1864, |error| 0.0400 inside the published 0.0500 budget. The 0.1.0 world this scenario pinned before was at 0.1278 - an error of 0.0586, OUTSIDE that budget.

fleet.description: Comms relay + Earth-link gateway. Real Hub digest - see PROVENANCE.md.
Cargo lander delivering the surface swarm. Real Hub digest - see PROVENANCE.md.
Active-perception scout (neutron/NIR/GPR/drill). Real Hub digest - see PROVENANCE.md.

Granular excavation (bucket/auger), version 0.2.0 - the first excavator to declare a `tool` contact element (astro-mine-fleet#38), without which no library asset reaches the granular contact ladder. Real Hub digest - see PROVENANCE.md.
Moves regolith/ore to the extraction plant. Real Hub digest - see PROVENANCE.md.

Central thermal extraction -> purification -> water storage, version 0.2.0 - the first plant to declare a `water_gauge` (resource_storage, species water, si_unit kg). Without it the plant filled a tank nothing could read: Bench scores `water_mass` by matching a reading's species and unit, so a full plant was indistinguishable from a swarm that produced nothing (astro-mine-fleet#40). Real Hub digest - see PROVENANCE.md.

prospect.description: Water-ice belief prior over the default Shackleton grid, from public LOLA/Diviner/LEND/M3 datasets; the sealed GroundTruthField is realized per seed at runtime. Version 1.0.0 squares the GMRF SPDE operator so alpha=2 yields a valid Matern nu=1 field (astro-mine-prospect#39). Real Hub digest (belief prior only) - see PROVENANCE.md.

link.description: Lunar polar relay + DSN contact plan, version 0.3.0 - the plan's epoch window now spans the full 30-day mission this episode runs (43_200 x 60 s), so comms_robustness scores connectivity over the whole episode rather than being diluted by the ~29 days a 24 h window did not model (astro-mine-link#34). 1108 contact intervals (24 h/0.2.0 was 38). Its nodes carry the Fleet SADF asset ids (astro-mine.fleet.excavator, ...) so Sim binds each contact node to an agent by exact id match (0.2.0, astro-mine-link#30); the 3 DSN stations keep their catalogue ids and bind to no agent, which is correct - they are not robots in the swarm. Rebuilt against the 0.4.0 world, so its provenance.source_content_hashes.terrain is byte-identical to this scenario's world pin. Real Hub digest - see PROVENANCE.md.
